Title: Generally Available: Content Understanding in Microsoft Foundry

Body.Content:
With the general availability of Content Understanding, the service now enables connecting to Foundry models, allowing customers to use Foundry model deployments. Additional key updates include support for VNETs, Managed Identities, Customer Managed Keys (CMK), and expanded region coverage. The release also introduces simplified pricing, new domain analyzers, RAG analyzers, and agent tools. Notably, it emphasizes enhanced confidence scores, grounding, and segmentation and routing capabilities, all designed to improve the precision, security, and scalability of AI-powered content analysis and extraction in enterprise environments.

Learn more.
